vep_command: vep -i variants.vcf -o <out> --offline --cache --dir_cache <cache> --cache_version 116 --species homo_sapiens --assembly GRCh38 --format vcf --buffer_size 5000 --fork 1 --no_stats --quiet --force_overwrite --polyphen b --humdiv [--tab|--vcf|--json]
input: 16 single-base substitutions on chromosome 21 whose alternate residue the converted Ensembl VEP 116 cache's PolyPhen HumDiv matrices predict in each category (probably damaging, possibly damaging, benign, unknown), inside and outside a protein feature, on forward and reverse transcripts; the reference base is the GRCh38 primary assembly's

divergences_classified_against.source: the tree this corpus is committed with

generator: candidate records annotated with Ensembl VEP under the corpus flags, then scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py select --release 116 --assembly GRCh38 --suite pool38=<reference>=<candidates> --k 200 --seed 1 --cache <converted slice> --family-columns PolyPhen --covers ... --matrix tests/parity/matrix.tsv --flag=--polyphen --flag=b --flag=--humdiv; scripts/golden/prune_json_cache.py --gzip --drop sorted_exons --drop protein_features --drop protein_function_predictions --drop-except naming the coding transcripts the records reach, so those keep protein_features and protein_function_predictions and every other transcript drops them --perl-info <cache>/info.txt --cache-version 116 over the chromosome 21 slice scripts/data/storable_to_json.pl converted from the Ensembl VEP 116 GRCh38 cache; scripts/concordance/generate_reference_output.sh --corpus; scripts/golden/build_golden_corpus.py classify
